paper_title: Constraining dark photon parameters based on the very high energy observations of blazars
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Dark photon dark matter kinetic mixing constrained from VHE gamma-ray absorption via photon-dark photon scattering in DM spikes around Mrk 421/Mrk 501. Main result: epsilon ~ 1e-7 at 95% CL over mD ~ 0.03-1 eV (Fig 4). Only qualitative value quoted in text; the exclusion curve is not tabulated so data points are approximate.
